competencies.title: Demonstrate awareness of policies affecting ICT in education
competencies.description: Teachers should be aware of national and institutional ICT policies

competencies.title: Comply with ICT policies as they affect teaching-learning
competencies.description: Apply ICT policies in day-to-day teaching and learning activities

competencies.title: Contextualizes ICT policies to the learning environment
competencies.description: Adapt ICT policies to fit specific classroom and institutional contexts

competencies.title: Demonstrate understanding of concepts, principles and theories of ICT system as they apply to teaching-learning
competencies.description: Understand ICT frameworks and their application in education

competencies.title: Evaluate digital and non-digital learning resources in response to student's diverse needs
competencies.description: Critically assess resources for diverse learners

competencies.title: Develop digital learning resources to enhance teaching-learning
competencies.description: Create and design digital educational resources

competencies.title: Use ICT tools to develop 21st century skills
competencies.description: Develop information, media, technology, learning, innovation, and communication skills

competencies.title: Apply relevant Technology tools for classroom activities
competencies.description: Select and use appropriate technology for teaching

competencies.title: Use ICT knowledge to solve complex problems and support student collaborative activities
competencies.description: Leverage ICT to address educational challenges and promote collaboration

competencies.title: Model collaborative knowledge construction in face to face and virtual environments
competencies.description: Facilitate collaborative learning in both physical and digital spaces

competencies.title: Demonstrate competence in the technical operations of technology tools and systems
competencies.description: Master technical aspects of educational technology tools

competencies.title: Use technology tools to create new learning opportunities to support community of learners
competencies.description: Build learning communities using technology

competencies.title: Demonstrate proficiency in the use of technology tools to support teaching and learning
competencies.description: Efficiently use technology to enhance education

competencies.title: Manage technology-assisted instruction in an inclusive classroom environment
competencies.description: Organize technology-enhanced learning for all students

competencies.title: Exhibit leadership in shared decision-making using technology tools
competencies.description: Lead collaborative decision-making processes with technology

competencies.title: Explore existing and emerging technology to acquire additional content and pedagogical knowledge
competencies.description: Stay current with educational technology developments

competencies.title: Utilize technology tools in creating communities of practice
competencies.description: Build professional learning networks using technology

competencies.title: Collaborate with peers, colleagues and stakeholders to access information in support of professional learning
competencies.description: Work together to support continuous professional development

competencies.title: Demonstrate social, ethical, and legal responsibility in the use of technology tools and resources
competencies.description: Use technology responsibly and ethically

competencies.title: Show positive attitude towards the use of technology tools
competencies.description: Maintain enthusiasm and openness toward educational technology
